7376 genes used for scoring against Pancreatic ## Calculating scores... ## Completed scoring for Pancreatic # Score all samples using the Metastatic PAAD signature scores_met <- PhenoMap(   expression = bulk_mat,   reference = "precog",   cancer_type = "Pancreatic_Metastasis",   verbose = TRUE ) ## 2997 genes used for scoring against Pancreatic_Metastasis ## Calculating scores... ## Completed scoring for Pancreatic_Metastasis # make a combined dataframe of sample clinical annotations and PhenoMap scores  col_pan <- grep("Pancreatic$", colnames(scores_primary), value = TRUE)[1] col_met <- grep("Pancreatic_Metastasis", colnames(scores_met), value = TRUE)[1] scores_df <- data.frame(   sample_id = rownames(scores_primary),   score_Pancreatic = if (!is.na(col_pan)) scores_primary[[col_pan]] else NA_real_,   score_Pancreatic_Metastasis = if (!is.na(col_met)) scores_met[[col_met]] else NA_real_,   stringsAsFactors = FALSE ) dat <- merge(pheno, scores_df, by = "sample_id") # Summary histogram: Primary and Metastatic PhenoMapR scores (scaled) score_long <- data.frame(   score = c(dat$score_Pancreatic, dat$score_Pancreatic_Metastasis),   type = rep(c("Pancreatic (Primary)", "Pancreatic (Metastasis)"), each = nrow(dat)) )   scale_preserve_sign <- function(x) {   # Scale negative values: -1 to 0   neg_idx <- x < 0   if (any(neg_idx)) {     x[neg_idx] <- x[neg_idx] / abs(min(x, na.rm = TRUE))   }   # Scale positive values: 0 to 1   pos_idx <- x > 0   if (any(pos_idx)) {     x[pos_idx] <- x[pos_idx] / max(x, na.rm = TRUE)   }   return(x) }  score_long$score_scale = scale_preserve_sign(score_long$score)  ggplot(score_long, aes(x = score_scale, fill = type)) +   geom_histogram(alpha = 0.8, position = "identity", bins = 30) +   scale_fill_manual(values = c("Pancreatic (Primary)" = "tan", "Pancreatic (Metastasis)" = "darkred")) +   labs(x = "PhenoMapR score (scaled)", y = "Count", fill = "Signature score", title = "PhenoMapR score distribution") +   theme_minimal()

title: Overview
text: Single-cell spatial transcriptomics methods provide improved resolution understanding cell types spatial organization underlying healthy malignant biology. However, many single-cell spatial studies lack sufficient sample size robust associations sample phenotype (e.g. overall survival) cell types spatial locations. contrast, lower resolution methods bulk gene expression profiling applied scale large, clinically-annotated datasets, providing robust signatures phenotype associations outcomes across cancers (e.g. PRECOG 2.0). PhenoMapR bridges gap improved resolution single-cell/spatial approaches robust phenotype signals identified across bulk expression studies mapping phenotypic signal directly onto individual cells spatial locations. Although developed cancer-centric focus, PhenoMapR can used map phenotypic signal associated bulk expression datasets across transcriptomic data modalities.

Format Subsamples sample_cap values: * "z_scaled" substantial fraction (>=10\ values negative per-column mean close 0. * "raw_counts" >=99\ integers. * "cpm_or_tpm" column sums cluster near 1e6 matrix max large (>50) – TPM CPM indistinguishable without gene-length info. * "log_normalized" values non-negative, mostly non-integer, max moderate (typically <20). * "unknown" otherwise. Single-cell vs bulk Combines sparsity (fraction zeros across sampled values) number samples (columns). Sparsity >=0.5 (>=200 samples sparsity >=0.3) -> single cell; <200 samples sparsity <0.3 -> bulk; everything else -> unclear.
